It was already over, but until now, the concept of no return was an abstraction. Now that I'm alone and dying, slowly and painfully, the bitter irony isn't lost on me. I only wish I'd made more time to travel, to finally go to Cambridge and lecture. 

It all feels so small. I feel small, insignificant, in the face of such terrible evolutionary majesty. I am somehow in awe of them, these creatures I mean, even as their presence has doomed us all. Let my legacy be this discovery. Let my name mean something, someday. I need to conserve whatever strength I have for the long night ahead.
